audit.why: Lane difficulty is correct: Blitzcrank is favoured the entire game since Senna has zero dash or self-peel and her poke never offsets the threat of a landed hook — matches the packet's levelChart (Blitzcrank on all 7 rows) and the FAVOURED diff rating.

Power spikes correctly cover the level 1-2 range mismatch, the Overdrive/Power Fist combo denying her disengage window, level-6 Static Field beating her Dawning Shadow cast, and full-build immobility still losing to a single hook.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.foe[1] both attribute Senna's root to her E ('E-black-mist window', 'Root Blitz with E'), but the root is her W, Last Embrace — E, Curse of the Black Mist, is a camouflage/stealth zone with no root. breakdown.cooldowns also has no cooldown number despite naming Last Embrace matchup-defining.
audit.why: enemyAbilities confirms W = Last Embrace (text: 'rooting them and everything nearby') and E = Curse of the Black Mist (text: camouflaged wraiths, no CC flag — only 'zone'). The kit's own hardCC flag sits on W, not E. Last Embrace is a flat 11s cooldown; Blitzcrank's W Overdrive is a flat 15s.
audit.corrected: Fix both fields to attribute the root to W; add real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.
